lead: A parameter-name hint is drawn *inside* the literal it annotates, so a `.lspt` case freezing one opens a new column in the coverage matrix.
body: A case answering `times:` over `greet("world", 2)` credited `inlayHint` with `Int`, which no cursor request had a case at, so the coverage gate came back asking for seven cases nobody meant to owe. Freeze the rendering at a construct the corpus already reaches — a second `string` argument does it — and leave the shape that opens a column to the crate's own Rust test.
